transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I feel like I’ve been stuck in this low, heavy mood for years and I just don’t enjoy anything the way I used to. It just feels like I'm constantly going through the motions every single day without any real relief.
Have you ever had a period of at least two months when your mood and interest felt back to normal, or has this low mood been present most days for years without a long break?

No, there haven't been any breaks at all. This heavy feeling has been constant and steady for a little over two years now, ever since I took on more patients at work and started helping my mom. I haven't had even a few weeks, let alone two months, where I felt back to my normal self.
Over these past two years, have you also had symptoms like poor appetite or overeating, trouble sleeping or sleeping too much, low energy, low self-esteem, or difficulty concentrating?

Yes, I've been struggling with several of those, especially my sleep and appetite. I barely eat during the day and just pick at crackers for dinner, and at night I lie awake with my mind racing only to wake up at 3 AM unable to drift back off. It leaves me so completely exhausted that even basic chores or trying to paint feel like climbing a massive hill.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or wanting to end my life. But I do often feel incredibly heavy and exhausted, and sometimes I feel really hopeless about things ever getting better.
Before these past two years, did you ever have a major depressive episode that lasted at least two weeks and then improved, or has this been a continuous low mood without any separate episodes?

No, I’ve never experienced anything like this before in my life; I used to be very active, enthusiastic, and really enjoyed my art and hiking. This low, heavy feeling only started about two years ago when my work and caring for my mom piled up, and it has just been one continuous, steady weight ever since.

How much has this low mood been affecting your daily functioning at work, at home, and in relationships? For example, are you still able to keep up with responsibilities, or has it become very difficult to function?

It has really taken a toll on my daily life. At work, I find myself doing the bare minimum and turning down extra shifts or new cases that I used to jump at. I've also completely stopped going to art classes and outings with my friends because I just don't have the energy to participate anymore.

Have you ever had a period of several days or more where you felt unusually energized or irritable, needed much less sleep, talked more than usual, or did risky things that were out of character for you?
No, I've never experienced anything like that at all. It has actually been the exact opposite for me, where I just feel consistently low, heavy, and completely drained of energy.
Have you had any periods during these past two years when your symptoms were clearly worse for at least two weeks, with a more severe depressive episode on top of the ongoing low mood?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't noticed any specific two-week periods where things got significantly worse than they already are. It has just felt like a steady, constant heavy mood the entire time.
During these past two years, have you ever had a distinct two-week period where your symptoms became much worse than usual, with more severe depression than the constant low mood you already had?
No, I haven't really noticed any specific two-week period where things suddenly got worse. It has just felt like a constant, steady heavy mood the entire time without those kinds of sudden drops.
During these past two years, have you also had low self-esteem, feelings of hopelessness, or trouble concentrating most days?

Yes, I definitely feel a strong sense of hopelessness, like this gray, heavy mood is just how my life is going to be from now on. I haven't really noticed major issues with my self-esteem or concentration, but that feeling of hopelessness and just going through the motions is very prominent.

Have you had any periods during these past two years when your symptoms were clearly absent or much milder for at least a couple of months, or has the low mood been present most days without any long break?

No, there haven't been any breaks or milder periods at all. It has been a steady, continuous weight almost every single day for the past two years without any relief. It just doesn't seem to lift, even for a little while.

Have you ever had a distinct major depressive episode lasting at least 2 weeks on top of this ongoing low mood, or has it always just been the same steady depression without any separate worsening periods?

No, it has always just been the same steady depression without any separate, worse periods. It feels like a continuous, heavy gray film that has stayed at the exact same level the entire time, with no sudden drops or changes.
Have you ever had a full major depressive episode in the past, lasting at least 2 weeks, before this continuous low mood started?

No, I’ve never experienced a major depressive episode or felt this kind of persistent low mood before things started about two years ago. Prior to that, I was generally a very active, happy person and never had any issues like this.
Just to confirm, has this low mood been present on most days for at least 2 years without ever fully going away for more than a couple of months?

Yes, that's exactly right. This low, heavy mood has been with me pretty much every single day for a little over two years now, ever since my workload increased and I started helping my mom. It has never gone away or lifted, not even for a few weeks, let alone a couple of months.
During this time, have there been most days when you felt depressed or down, or lost interest or pleasure in things, nearly every day?

Yes, almost every single day for the past two years, it has felt like there is a gray film over everything and I'm just going through the motions. I've completely lost interest in the activities I used to love, like my art classes and outings with friends. It really is a constant feeling that is there nearly every single day.

Have you ever had a stretch of at least 2 weeks during these past two years when your symptoms became clearly more severe than your usual low mood, with several major depression symptoms at the same time?

No, I haven't really noticed any specific two-week periods where things suddenly got much worse than they already are. It has just been a constant, steady heaviness that doesn't seem to let up at all.

Just to make sure I understand: during the past two years, have you ever had a separate period of at least 2 weeks when you felt much worse than your usual low mood, with several depressive symptoms clearly intensifying at the same time?
No, I haven't noticed any specific two-week periods where things got significantly worse than my usual low mood. It has just felt like a steady, constant heaviness for the past two years.
Have you ever had any period of at least 2 weeks in your life when you felt much more depressed than usual, with several symptoms getting clearly worse at the same time?
No, I've never had any periods like that in my life. It has really just been this constant, steady, and heavy low mood that has been hanging over me pretty much every day for the past two-plus years.
Have you ever had a separate period of at least 2 weeks when your depression became clearly worse than your usual low mood, with several symptoms intensifying at the same time?
No, I haven't noticed any separate times where it got significantly worse than this constant, heavy feeling. It has just been a steady, ongoing struggle the entire time.
